proposed_facts.reason: Independently read all three cited ranges. LoadSpecialAttrs invokes COPY_ATTRS, whose typed assignment copies external attributes through the existing dat_attrs pointer without rebinding it. OnLoad invokes PUSH_ATTRS, which copies into dat_attrs_backup and activates that storage. The functionality document preserves this distinction and makes no broader lifetime guarantee.
